items.title: Einspruch against the advance-payment assessment
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Einspruch beim Finanzamt Beispielsoest eingelegt werden, schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: Posting (Aufgabe zur Post) stated as Saturday 21.11.2026. The letter claims the Bescheid is deemed bekanntgegeben 'am vierten Tag' after posting, but the statutory rule under § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO is the THIRD day after posting (unless the third day is a Saturday/Sunday/holiday, in which case it shifts to the next business day). Counting the statutory 3 days from Sat 21.11.2026: day1=Sun 22.11., day2=Mon 23.11., day3=Tue 24.11.2026 (a normal weekday) -> Bekanntgabe = 24.11.2026. Since this is earlier than the letter's own (incorrect) 4-day statement (which would give 25.11.2026), the earlier/stricter date is used per the rule to take the earliest plausible deadline. The one-month Einspruchsfrist (§ 355 Abs. 1 AO) then runs per §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB: the day of Bekanntgabe (24.11.2026) is not counted; the period ends one month later on the day bearing the same number, i.e. 24.12.2026. 24.12.2026 is a Thursday and not a statutory public holiday in NRW (Heiligabend is not a Feiertag), so no further shift is needed.

items.quote: setzen wir die Vorauszahlungen zur Einkommensteuer ab 2027 auf 1.120,00 € je Quartal fest, fällig jeweils am 10.03., 10.06., 10.09. und 10.12.

warnings: The letter states the Bescheid is deemed delivered 'am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post', but the governing rule under § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO is the THIRD day after posting; this discrepancy shifts the calculated Einspruch deadline by several days depending on which rule is applied (24.12.2026 under the correct statutory 3-day rule vs. a later date in late December if the letter's literal 4-day wording is applied) — verify the actual date the letter arrived and, to be safe, aim to file any Einspruch no later than 24.12.2026.

The advance-payment amount of 1.120,00 € per quarter is based on the 2025 profit from freelance translation work; if 2027 income will differ significantly, an adjustment ('Anpassung') can be requested by submitting a forecast ('Prognose'), but no deadline for this is given in the letter.
